categories.label: Make Statement
categories.definition: Make a public statement: declare, comment, announce, deny, or express an opinion about a situation (CAMEO 01).

categories.label: Appeal
categories.definition: Appeal: request, ask for or call for action, aid, cooperation, restraint or change from another party (CAMEO 02).

categories.label: Cooperate
categories.definition: Express intent to cooperate: offer, agree or pledge to cooperate, negotiate, accept mediation or settle a dispute (CAMEO 03).

categories.label: Consult
categories.definition: Consult: discuss by telephone, meet, visit, host a visit, engage in negotiation or mediation (CAMEO 04).

categories.label: Engage in Diplomatic Cooperation
categories.definition: Engage in diplomatic cooperation: praise, endorse, grant recognition, apologise, forgive, sign formal agreements (CAMEO 05).

categories.label: Engage in Material Cooperation
categories.definition: Engage in material cooperation: cooperate economically, militarily, judicially, or share intelligence and information (CAMEO 06).

categories.label: Provide Aid
categories.definition: Provide aid: economic, military, humanitarian aid, asylum or shelter (CAMEO 07).

categories.label: Yield
categories.definition: Yield: ease restrictions or sanctions, release persons, return property, allow access, cease fighting, accede to demands (CAMEO 08).

categories.label: Investigate
categories.definition: Investigate: investigate crimes, corruption, human-rights abuses, military actions or war crimes (CAMEO 09).

categories.label: Demand
categories.definition: Demand: demand material, diplomatic or political cooperation, policy change, rights, release, ceasefire, withdrawal (CAMEO 10).

categories.label: Approve
categories.definition: Approve (added category, positive counterpart of Disapprove): express approval, endorse, praise, defend or vouch for a policy, person or action.

categories.label: Disapprove
categories.definition: Disapprove: criticise, denounce, rally opposition, complain officially, bring a lawsuit, find guilty (CAMEO 11).

categories.label: Accuse
categories.definition: Accuse: accuse of crime, corruption, human-rights abuses, aggression, war crimes or espionage (CAMEO 112).

categories.label: Reject
categories.definition: Reject: refuse or decline cooperation, proposals, demands, mediation, ceasefire, withdrawal, investigation (CAMEO 12).

categories.label: Threaten
categories.definition: Threaten: threaten non-force or force, sanctions, restrictions, blockade, repression, attack, ultimatum (CAMEO 13).

categories.label: Protest
categories.definition: Protest: demonstrate, rally, hunger strike, strike or boycott, obstruct passage, protest violently (CAMEO 14).

categories.label: Exhibit Force
categories.definition: Exhibit force posture: increase police or military alert status, mobilise or increase forces, show of force, military exercise (CAMEO 15).

categories.label: Reduce Relations
categories.definition: Reduce relations: reduce or break diplomatic relations, reduce aid, impose embargo, sanctions or boycott, halt negotiations or mediation, expel (CAMEO 16).

categories.label: Coerce
categories.definition: Coerce: seize or damage property, impose restrictions, ban, curfew, arrest, detain, expel, deport, use repression (CAMEO 17).

categories.label: Assault
categories.definition: Assault: abduct, physically assault, torture, kill, conduct bombing, car bombing or suicide attack, sexually assault (CAMEO 18).

categories.label: Fight
categories.definition: Fight: impose blockade, occupy territory, fight with small arms, artillery, tanks, aerial weapons, violate ceasefire (CAMEO 19).

categories.label: Mass Violence
categories.definition: Use unconventional mass violence: engage in mass expulsion, mass killing, ethnic cleansing, use weapons of mass destruction (CAMEO 20).
